transcript.text: Let me search for the relevant ISC role assignment APIs.
The `createAccessRequest` result looks promising. Let me get its full spec and also search more specifically for role-related operations.

Both grant and revoke use the **same single endpoint** — `POST /v3/access-requests` — differentiated only by the `requestType` field.

---

## Grant a Role

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
  "requestedFor": ["2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"],
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ROLE",
      "id": "2c9180887701fb2014143dcb365a158c",
      "comment": "Granting role for onboarding"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Revoke a Role

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "requestType": "REVOKE_ACCESS",
  "requestedFor": ["2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"],
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ROLE",
      "id": "2c9180887701fb2014143dcb365a158c",
      "comment": "Revoking role — offboarding"
    }
  ]
}
```

---

## Key notes

| Field | Values / Notes |
|---|---|
| `requestType` | `GRANT_ACCESS` or `REVOKE_ACCESS` |
| `requestedFor` | Array of **identity IDs** (not usernames) |
| `requestedItems[].type` | `ROLE` (also supports `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ENTITLEMENT`) |
| `requestedItems[].id` | The role's ID (get it from `GET /v3/roles`) |
| `requestedItems[].comment` | Optional but recommended for audit trail |

**Important:** This endpoint goes through the standard ISC approval workflow. If the role requires approval, the access isn't granted/revoked instantly — you'll receive a request ID back and the change is pending approval. Use `GET /v3/access-request-status` with the returned request ID to poll the outcome.

### Required OAuth scope
Use either `idn:access-request:manage` (admin/service accounts) or `idn:access-request-self:manage` (self-service only).

---

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [idn:access-request:manage]
key_parameters: [requestType, requestedFor, requestedItems, type, id, comment]
```
